announcements.headline: EQS-News: Krones reports moderate growth and improved profitability in a challenging market environment
announcements.insight: Krones adjusted its revenue growth forecast in October following earlier reports of increased order intake. This guidance change signals a shift from the previously reported moderate growth trajectory.

announcements.headline: EQS-AFR: Krones AG: Preliminary announcement of the publication of quarterly reports and quarterly/interim statements
announcements.insight: Krones AG announces quarterly reports. This follows its H1 2026 update and a guidance adjustment in October.

announcements.headline: EQS-Adhoc: Krones Aktiengesellschaft: Krones adjusts its revenue growth forecast for fiscal year 2026 and medium-term targets for 2028
announcements.insight: Krones adjusts its revenue growth forecast for fiscal year 2026 and medium-term targets for 2028. This guidance change follows the H1 2026 profitability increase announced in July.

announcements.headline: EQS-DD: Krones AG: Schawei GmbH, buy
announcements.insight: Krones AG acquires Schawei GmbH. This follows H1 2026 results showing increased order intake and profitability, suggesting continued strategic expansion.

announcements.headline: EQS-DD: Krones AG: Schawei GmbH, Kauf
announcements.insight: Krones AG acquires Schawei GmbH, following its July 2026 update on increased order intake and profitability.

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Krones further increases order intake and profitability in first half of 2026
announcements.insight: Krones AG reports increased order intake and profitability for the first half of 2026. This follows a preliminary announcement regarding the publication of financial reports in July 2026.

announcements.headline: EQS-AFR: Krones AG: Preliminary announcement of the publication of financial reports according to Articles 114, 115, 117 of the WpHG [the German Securities Act]
announcements.insight: Krones AG announces the publication of financial reports under German Securities Act provisions. Shareholders should await the full report for details.

announcements.headline: EQS-PVR: Krones AG: Release according to Article 40, Section 1 of the WpHG [the German Securities Trading Act] with the objective of Europe-wide distribution
